conceptBlocks.text: 合同差价衡量履约价格偏离，历史变动率衡量同供应商同商品的成交价波动。

items: 承诺成本=订购数量×成交单价；加权单价=总采购金额÷总订购量。
历史基准须在报告期过滤前计算。

syntax.purpose: 采购成本与价格差异的语法模板如下，各部分含义见下方说明。

problem: 采购分析师需要找出成交价格偏离合同或历史价格的采购行，并评估供应商比价机会。所有金额以马币分表示；采购承诺不是已收货或已付款金额。

methodBlocks.text: 原企业查询先连接采购行、采购订单及合同，排除取消订单。窗口按供应商和商品分区，以订单日期及行编号确定先后；这样同日多行仍按同一规则排列。
先取历史上一行，再筛2025年，避免第一笔年度采购丢失上年基准。合同差价=成交单价−合同单价；
历史变动率=(成交单价−上一采购行单价)/上一采购行单价×100，分母为零或缺失时留空。跨供应商比较采用数量加权价，先汇总金额与数量，不能直接平均单价。
采购承诺金额采用已批准的订购数量×成交单价；不同的审批状态需按业务规则分别处理。

breakdown.title: 在采购行匹配合同并取历史上一笔价格
breakdown.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT i.po_item_id,p.supplier_id,i.product_id,p.order_date,i.unit_price_cents,c.unit_price_cents contract_cents,LAG(i.unit_price_cents) OVER(PARTITION BY p.supplier_id,i.product_id ORDER BY p.order_date,i.po_item_id) previous_cents FROM purchase_order_items i JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.po_id=i.po_id JOIN supplier_contracts c ON c.contract_id=i.contract_id WHERE p.status<>'cancelled')
SELECT * FROM a ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 LIMIT 3;
breakdown.purpose: 给每行采购匹配合同价 contract_cents，并取同一供应商、同一商品的上一笔采购单价 previous_cents。
breakdown.reason: LAG 按供应商和商品分区、按日期排序，才是“同一商品的上一次采购价”；已取消的采购行不参与。

breakdown.title: 计算合同价差与价格环比
breakdown.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT i.po_item_id,p.supplier_id,i.product_id,p.order_date,i.unit_price_cents,c.unit_price_cents contract_cents,LAG(i.unit_price_cents) OVER(PARTITION BY p.supplier_id,i.product_id ORDER BY p.order_date,i.po_item_id) previous_cents FROM purchase_order_items i JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.po_id=i.po_id JOIN supplier_contracts c ON c.contract_id=i.contract_id WHERE p.status<>'cancelled') SELECT po_item_id,supplier_id,product_id,unit_price_cents,contract_cents,unit_price_cents-contract_cents contract_variance_cents,previous_cents,ROUND(100.0*(unit_price_cents-previous_cents)/NULLIF(previous_cents,0),2) change_pct FROM a WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' ORDER BY po_item_id
breakdown.purpose: 计算与合同价的差额、与上一笔价格的变动百分比，只保留 2025 年的采购行。
breakdown.reason: 先用全部历史算出上一笔价格，最后才筛 2025 年，年初的第一笔才有上一笔可以比较。

resultBlocks.text: 小型示例中第2行成交120分，合同110分，差10分；较上一行100分上涨20%。第3行90分，较合同低20分，较上一行下降25%。供应商2首次采购无历史基准，不等于涨幅0%。
供应商1商品10的加权价为(20×120+10×90)/30=110分，供应商2为100分，溢价10%。应进一步核查同规格、币种、税费、运费和采购批量。
原企业结果前3行分别为采购行2、3、4；第2行合同差为0但历史涨幅6.52%，说明两个基准回答不同问题。企业结果为原仓库预览，本次未重跑。

extensions.label: 历史价格基准

explanationBlocks.text: 先排除取消行，再在同供应商同商品内按日期和编号取上一行。

extensions.sql:
WITH purchase_lines(id,supplier_id,product_id,order_date,qty,price,contract_price,status) AS (
 VALUES (1,1,10,'2024-12-20',10,100,100,'approved'),
 (2,1,10,'2025-01-05',20,120,110,'approved'),
 (3,1,10,'2025-02-05',10,90,110,'approved'),
 (4,2,10,'2025-01-06',30,100,100,'approved'),
 (5,1,10,'2025-01-10',99,500,110,'cancelled'),
 (6,2,20,'2025-02-03',5,200,200,'approved')
), valid AS (SELECT * FROM purchase_lines WHERE status<>'cancelled'), history AS (SELECT *, LAG(price) OVER(PARTITION BY supplier_id,product_id ORDER BY order_date,id) previous_price FROM valid) SELECT id,price,previous_price FROM history ORDER BY price DESC

extensions.label: 完整价格差异

explanationBlocks.text: 保留历史后才筛选2025年，比较合同与历史两个不同基准。

extensions.sql:
WITH purchase_lines(id,supplier_id,product_id,order_date,qty,price,contract_price,status) AS (
 VALUES (1,1,10,'2024-12-20',10,100,100,'approved'),
 (2,1,10,'2025-01-05',20,120,110,'approved'),
 (3,1,10,'2025-02-05',10,90,110,'approved'),
 (4,2,10,'2025-01-06',30,100,100,'approved'),
 (5,1,10,'2025-01-10',99,500,110,'cancelled'),
 (6,2,20,'2025-02-03',5,200,200,'approved')
), valid AS (SELECT * FROM purchase_lines WHERE status<>'cancelled'), history AS (SELECT *, LAG(price) OVER(PARTITION BY supplier_id,product_id ORDER BY order_date,id) previous_price FROM valid) SELECT id,price,contract_price,price-contract_price AS variance,previous_price,ROUND(100.0*(price-previous_price)/NULLIF(previous_price,0),2) AS change_pct FROM history WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' ORDER BY price DESC

extensions.label: 采购承诺成本

explanationBlocks.text: 以有效且已批准的订购数量乘成交单价，金额单位为分。

extensions.sql:
WITH purchase_lines(id,supplier_id,product_id,order_date,qty,price,contract_price,status) AS (
 VALUES (1,1,10,'2024-12-20',10,100,100,'approved'),
 (2,1,10,'2025-01-05',20,120,110,'approved'),
 (3,1,10,'2025-02-05',10,90,110,'approved'),
 (4,2,10,'2025-01-06',30,100,100,'approved'),
 (5,1,10,'2025-01-10',99,500,110,'cancelled'),
 (6,2,20,'2025-02-03',5,200,200,'approved')
), valid AS (SELECT * FROM purchase_lines WHERE status<>'cancelled') SELECT supplier_id,SUM(qty*price) AS committed_cents FROM valid WHERE status='approved' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY supplier_id ORDER BY committed_cents DESC

extensions.label: 跨供应商加权比价

explanationBlocks.text: 先按商品供应商汇总，再比较至少两家供应商的商品；保留未舍入的价格计算溢价。

extensions.sql:
WITH purchase_lines(id,supplier_id,product_id,order_date,qty,price,contract_price,status) AS (
 VALUES (1,1,10,'2024-12-20',10,100,100,'approved'),
 (2,1,10,'2025-01-05',20,120,110,'approved'),
 (3,1,10,'2025-02-05',10,90,110,'approved'),
 (4,2,10,'2025-01-06',30,100,100,'approved'),
 (5,1,10,'2025-01-10',99,500,110,'cancelled'),
 (6,2,20,'2025-02-03',5,200,200,'approved')
), valid AS (SELECT * FROM purchase_lines WHERE status<>'cancelled'), w AS (SELECT product_id,supplier_id,1.0*SUM(qty*price)/NULLIF(SUM(qty),0) weighted_price FROM valid WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY product_id,supplier_id), b AS (SELECT *,MIN(weighted_price) OVER(PARTITION BY product_id) cheapest,COUNT(weighted_price) OVER(PARTITION BY product_id) suppliers FROM w) SELECT product_id,supplier_id,ROUND(weighted_price,2) weighted_price,ROUND(100.0*(weighted_price-cheapest)/NULLIF(cheapest,0),2) premium_pct FROM b WHERE suppliers>=2 ORDER BY weighted_price

comparison.text: 合同差价不是采购总成本差额；跨供应商比较需统一商品规格与成本口径。

example.text: 先筛2025年再用 LAG，或直接平均各次采购单价。

reason.text: 先筛 2025 年再用 LAG，2025 年的第一笔采购就找不到上一笔价格；直接平均各次采购单价会忽略采购数量，应当用总金额除以总数量得到加权价。

correction.text: 保留历史后计算窗口；按总金额除以总数量计算加权价。
